title: Privacy and Publication
headline: A small, deliberate footprint.
intro: This preview is static: it has no third-party fonts, advertising tags, cookies, trackers or submission forms.
summary: Production privacy statements must reflect the deployed HTTPS service, logging, contact facilities and any future consentful analytics rather than make premature assurances.

sections.heading: What the preview actually does
sections.body: The generated pages contain local HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a favicon. Mobile navigation uses local browser state only; the preview does not submit information or load third-party services.

sections.heading: What changes on a live host
sections.body: An HTTPS server naturally processes network requests and may log technical events. Its real logging, retention, access, authentication and data handling need to be documented against the deployed configuration before the production privacy page is approved.
